Names.fsm.message: Every entry point needs a name.

Name 'Names' is used more than once in the state machine.

Points.fsm.message: Only composite states can have entry/exit points; add a region to 'Simple'.
Transitions leaving entry point 'in' must target a vertex inside 'C'.
Transitions leaving exit point 'out' must target a vertex outside 'C'.
Entry point 'start' of the state machine has no outgoing transition.
Exit point 'stop' of the state machine cannot have outgoing transitions; the referencing submachine state continues from its connection point reference.

Protocol.fsm.message: States of a protocol state machine cannot have entry/exit/do behaviors ('A').
Use a precondition instead of a guard in a protocol state machine.

Pseudostates.fsm.message: History pseudostates are only meaningful inside a composite state.
Transitions leaving a fork cannot have guards or triggers.
A join must have exactly one outgoing transition.
Transitions entering a join cannot have guards or triggers.
Every branch of a choice with several outgoing transitions should have a guard.
Consider an [else] branch so the choice can always be left.
A choice must have at least one incoming transition.
A choice must have at least one outgoing transition.
A fork must have exactly one incoming transition.
A fork must have at least two outgoing transitions.
The sources of a join should be in different orthogonal regions.
The targets of a fork should be in different orthogonal regions.
Transitions leaving a pseudostate cannot have triggers (from 'fork1*').

Reachability.fsm.message: The top-level region has no initial pseudostate.

Text.fsm.message: Pre/postconditions only apply to protocol state machines and are ignored.
entry of 'A': Functions take no arguments: write start().
exit of 'A': '1' is not allowed: the state machine has no variables, so use function calls like isReady() combined with !, && and ||.
do of 'A': Expected a function call.
Invariant of 'A': Expected a function call.
Stereotype of 'A': 'Bad Name' is not a valid name: use letters, digits and _ only, not starting with a digit.
Deferrable event of 'A': '2bad' is not a valid event name (letters, digits and _ only).
Action: Functions take no arguments: write init().
Trigger: 'go now' is not a valid event name (letters, digits and _ only).
Action: '1' is not allowed: the state machine has no variables, so use function calls like isReady() combined with !, && and ||.
Precondition: Functions take no arguments: write p().
